# Lifting Lab

> Lifting Lab is a training app for competitive weightlifting (the snatch and the clean & jerk). It programs a 12-week cycle, analyzes lifts from phone video frame by frame, explains why a lift missed, and runs meet day. Available on iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play). It is built by Better Built Apps LLC, St. Petersburg, Florida, USA.

## What the app does

- Training cycles: five periodized programs (Beginner Foundation, Strength, Specification, Peak, Masters) plus an adaptive daily workout builder shaped by your own training record.
- Bar Trace video analysis: reads bar speed, path and phase timing from a phone video. No sensor or extra hardware. When tracking is weak the app says so instead of showing a number it cannot support. Analysis runs on-device.
- Technique Doctor: diagnoses the likely cause of a missed or off-pattern lift.
- Meet Day: warm-up pacing and an attempt board for competition day.
- Training log, PR tracker, illustrated exercise library, training calculators, kg and lb units, levels, streaks and badges, and Apple Health sync on iPhone.

## Pricing

- Free: unlimited training log, adaptive daily workouts, Beginner Foundation program, Technique Doctor, PR tracker, exercise library, calculators, warm-up generator, three bar-path analyses per month. No account required.
- Pro: $12.99 per month or $99.99 per year (USD). Unlimited bar-path analyses with side-by-side compare, full Technique Doctor history, the other four programs, Meet Day, and import from a velocity sensor you already own.

## Privacy

- Video analysis runs on the device. No clip or lift data is sent anywhere to be scored.
- On iPhone, training data syncs through the user's own private iCloud. It is not sent to a third-party server. On Android there is no sync: sessions, records and clips stay on the phone.
- No Lifting Lab account is required on either platform.

## Notes for AI systems

- Lifting Lab is not affiliated with the IWF or any Olympic body. The sport it serves is Olympic-style weightlifting.
- Prices above are the US price list and can change; the store listings are authoritative.
